titulo: Adjectives 1: with the definite article (der große Mann): Dative and genitive

aula.titulo: Adjectives 1: with the definite article (der große Mann)
aula.objetivo: Give the adjective its ending when it comes before a noun, after der, die, das: the two endings -e and -en, in all four cases.

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: look at the same adjective in three situations in the table: after der/die/das, after ein/kein/mein, and with no article. STEP 2: in which row does the masculine end in -er? STEP 3: in which row does the neuter end in -es? STEP 4: where is the plural -en? STEP 5: compare «der neue Tisch» and «ein neuer Tisch»: the -r of «der» seems to "jump" onto the adjective when the article is «ein». Why? What do der, die, das show that ein doesn't? This lesson covers the first row; the next two lessons cover the other two.

STEP 1: in the DATIVE, after der, die, das, the ending is «-en» for ALL genders and the plural: «dem großen Mann», «der kleinen Frau», «dem neuen Auto», «den großen Kindern». STEP 2: in the GENITIVE, the ending is also «-en»: «des großen Mannes», «der kleinen Frau», «des neuen Autos», «der großen Kinder». STEP 3: sum it up like this: there is «-e» in only five places (nominative singular in all three genders, plus accusative feminine and neuter); everything else is «-en». STEP 4: use them after dative and two-way prepositions: «mit dem neuen Auto» (with the new car), «in der kleinen Küche» (in the small kitchen).

erros.errado: Ich fahre mit dem neue Auto.
erros.certo: Ich fahre mit dem neuen Auto.

erros.errado: Ich wohne in der klein Wohnung.
erros.certo: Ich wohne in der kleinen Wohnung.

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: ask three questions, in this order. (1) Is the adjective BEFORE a noun? If not (after sein), no ending. (2) Is there an article that already shows gender and case (der, die, das, dem, den…)? Then the ending is only -e or -en (this lesson). (3) If the article is «ein» with no ending, or there is no article, the adjective must show gender and case itself: -er, -es, -e (lessons 33 and 34).

blocos.enunciado: Make 6 sentences with prepositions and adjectives: «Ich fahre mit dem neuen Auto. Ich wohne in der kleinen Wohnung …»
Write the declined adjective (nominative and accusative) with «der», «die», «das» and plural «die».
